newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Astra says has FDA approval for Naropin.
newsitem.headline: Astra says has FDA approval for Naropin.

text.p: Swedish drug group Astra AB said on Tuesday it had received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for its Naropin local anaesthetic and would be launching the drug in the United States.
"Naropin is the first new long-acting local anaesthetic to be introduced in the United States in over 20 years," Astra said in a statement.
The product would be marketed by Astra's U.S. subsidiary Astra USA, Inc, it said.
Naropin has been approved in 15 countries total and has been launched in five, it said.
Clinical studies on some 2,500 patients show the drug is effective and safe as a surgical and local anaesthetic, Astra said.
